dedupe_keys.name: netbox netreplica containerlab lab for building a network digital twin from a source of truth srl labs

description: This lab, published by the srl-labs community (Nokia SR Linux labs), shows how Containerlab can create virtual replicas, or digital twins, of a production network for testing. It deploys NetBox with seed data as the network source of truth, uses NetReplica (NRX) to turn the NetBox inventory into a Containerlab topology file for part of the sample network, and adds a Python script and templates for basic configuration management. Coverage: one sample network with a global OSPF backbone area. The walk-through tests a real operational change, moving the network from one interior gateway protocol to another, on the twin without downtime. Format and access: shell scripts, Python, templates and instructions on GitHub; free. Licence: not found in the repository files tried. Caveats: it is a demonstration lab with seed data, not a dataset of a real network; it was tested on Ubuntu 22.04 with Containerlab 0.51 and Docker 25, and was not run for this record. Simulation uses: building digital twins of IP networks from an inventory to rehearse changes and failures before applying them to live telecom networks. Related records: Containerlab (platform-containerlab) is the lab orchestrator it relies on.
